$comment: Known answers for home-loan prepayment (keep the EMI, shorten the tenure). Published worked examples found via web search on 2026-10-09 (direct fetch blocked in the build environment) give rounded figures, so each case has a tolerance. Exact behaviour is also checked in tools-core/test/prepayment.test.ts against the closed-form amortisation formulas (remaining balance and number of payments) from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mortgage_calculator.

cases.name: ₹25 lakh, 9%, 20 years, no prepayment

cases.name: ₹25 lakh, 9%, 20 years, ₹2 lakh prepaid at the start, EMI kept
cases.quote: your outstanding loan reduces to ₹23 lakh … new tenure about 195 months … total interest of about ₹20.84 lakh

cases.name: ₹50 lakh, 7.5%, 20 years, one extra EMI (₹40,280) every year
